steps.instructions: Investigate the current implementation of the user-specified feature. Do not edit source. Return file references, invariants and unknowns. Replace this instruction with the actual feature and relevant source paths.
Independently investigate existing tests for the same feature. Return evidence, coverage gaps and proposed acceptance criteria. Do not edit source.
Read both predecessor artifacts. Produce an implementation proposal separating evidence, inference and unresolved decisions. Do not treat either worker's confidence as proof.

validator.instructions: Review the proposal and its evidence before authorizing implementation.
